lenses.name: Career Route: From Starting Point to First Commitment
lenses.visual_thesis: A single evolving route turns the program overview into visible forward movement.
lenses.recurring_carrier: Continuous gold route line with milestone nodes
lenses.primary_risk: Could become diagram-heavy if too many route branches appear at once.

lenses.name: Build Your Career Field Guide
lenses.visual_thesis: A field guide assembles page by page, with tools, prompts, and completed actions becoming a personal playbook.
lenses.recurring_carrier: Oversized field-guide sheet with tabs, annotations, and stamped completions
lenses.primary_risk: The document metaphor may feel like a web page and weaken the journey/progress claim.

selected: Career Route: From Starting Point to First Commitment
selection_reason: The route lens maps directly to the script’s starting point, progress, milestones, practical movement, and first submission. It offers stronger continuous visual evolution than the field-guide lens and can communicate sequence without falling into a page or card-grid layout.
